text:
Maya: Short note 6 launching a small pilot to rework onboarding credits for nonprofit and education orgs. Goal: reduce invoice surprises while keeping eligibility simple.
Maya: TL;DR: 1) Replace the previous flat $50 onboarding credit with a tiered credit: $75 for qualifying charities, $40 for accredited educational orgs, applied automatically at first invoice. 2) Automatic tax treatment flag added so Finance can handle VAT/GST differently per region. 3) Credits are pilot-only and opt-outable.
Jorge: This is billing-layer only. No changes to runtime limits or rate throttles.
Tess: How will eligibility be verified?
Maya: Eligibility flow: during signup we request org verification (charity number or edu domain). For existing customers we run a one-time verification job and notify them before applying credits.
Finance: Need to know GL mapping and whether credits should post as contra-revenue or adjustments. Also need region-specific tax guidance for VAT reclaimable credits.
Legal: Quick check  pilot ok. Please add consent language: "By completing org verification you consent to apply pilot credits; terms subject to change." Also verify no false-advertising concerns.
Support: We'll need canned replies and an FAQ explaining how credits appear on the invoice (`onboard_credit_charity` / `onboard_credit_edu`), plus the verification flow and opt-out steps.
Maya: Visibility: invoices will include a clearly labeled line item and `credit_verification_id` metadata for traceability. We'll also show the credit amount in the billing UI before the first invoice posts.
Jorge: Deploy plan: billing-service `deploy/billing/2027-03-15/nonprofit-onboard-v1`. Backfill: for existing eligible accounts we'll run a non-destructive preview job that flags invoices but does not apply credits until customers confirm; opt-in for auto-apply available.
Billing-bot: INFO: scheduled deploy at 2027-03-15T07:00:00Z (2925012600).
Finance: Please post sample invoice CSVs with new line items for US/EU/UK tax teams. We'll confirm GL mapping within 48h.
Support: We'll prepare a short support playbook and an email template to notify customers about the preview and how to opt-out.
Maya: Monitoring: track `billing.onboard_credit_applied_count`, `billing.verification_failure_rate`, and alert if >1% of verifications fail or if reconciliation mismatches occur.
Jorge: Note  this should not affect reserved capacity semantics. Reserved customers on enterprise plans will get account-level handling and not the automatic credits unless requested.
Tess: For privacy: verification data stored encrypted, retention 90 days, will include who approved. Legal please confirm retention period.
Legal: Approved retention & wording, flag added `credit_preview_consent=true` when running previews.
Maya: Action items: Eng (Jorge) implement preview job & UI before deploy, Finance provide GL mapping & tax guidance (Finance), Support draft FAQ and templates (Support), Legal finalize consent text (Legal).
Support: Draft FAQ link: https://docs.redwood/support/nonprofit-onboard-credit.md (WIP).
Billing-bot: INFO: deploy started at 2027-03-15T07:00:12Z (2925012612).
Maya: Deploy finished. Preview job ran for 1200 eligible accounts; 200 flagged as needing manual verification. No incidents.
Finance: Early sample CSVs look good; will validate tax treatment and post follow-up.
Support: FAQ and email templates posted for review.
Maya: Thanks team  we'll collect metrics for 7 days and decide on GA. Closing thread for now.
